tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and raw prefixes support the archived coupled memory ODE, but five observations leave genuine parameter ambiguity. The extra-fine trajectory batch supplies the diverse observations needed to fit and confirm it.

considered_alternatives.option: Coupled two-state memory ODE fitted to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The four parameters and latent memory reconstruction are not sufficiently identified by five closely related trajectories; the archive specifies at least eight rows.
The observed history gap and transient lag point to the memory mechanism rather than a static sink-gradient branch.
It does not account for the observed dependence on past history at matched endpoints.
